What this viewer measures

It samples current training traces, buckets hops by observed model difficulty, and shows whether alternative query formulations would surface the gold document under the current helper. It also shows whether same-iteration parallel queries return distinct evidence or collapse onto the same top documents.

Non-trained stage estimate: from the prior stage-bucket sample, pure doc-read failures after the gold doc was read were about 0.5% of attempted hop states and about 1.6% of attempted-hop failures. So the claim is directionally right, but I would not phrase it as strictly below 1% unless the denominator includes blocked hops/all hop states.
